rule.statement: The current decision-log original-source census must parse its U/V/R sections with a nonzero U/V denominator, no parser errors, and R-001..R-008 index entries.

normal.precondition: The authenticated current decision-log contains all three required source sections.
normal.input: Parse the actual decision-log through deriveDecisionLogOriginalSourceCensus.
normal.observable_success: status=present, errors=[], entries and source_units each >=8, and R-001..R-008 indexed.
normal.observable_failure: A missing source section, empty denominator, or parser error is observable.

failure.precondition: A source section is missing from an in-memory copy.
failure.input: Remove the verbatim section before invoking the same parser.
failure.observable_success: The parser reports a named missing-section error.
failure.observable_failure: The mutated material yields errors=[] or is counted as covered.

boundary.precondition: U/V source lines and R index rows occupy distinct namespaces.
boundary.input: Parse the U/V/R rows in the current decision-log.
boundary.observable_success: U/V entries form the denominator; R entries are trace links, not added source units.
boundary.observable_failure: R rows inflate the source denominator or a required R ID is absent.

recovery.precondition: A missing section has been restored using authenticated material.
recovery.input: Reparse the corrected decision-log without changing the parser.
recovery.observable_success: The previously missing source section is recognized and parser errors clear.
recovery.observable_failure: The repaired text remains unparseable or the denominator stays zero.

cases.risk: A zero or inflated original-source denominator could make later coverage claims misleading; the focused parser test alone does not prove the official AC-26 diagnostic or phase conclusion. Independent business-effect evidence remains unknown because no separate before/after reader has been authenticated.
cases.environment: Local Node v24.14.0 and Vitest 2.1.9; current decision-log bytes, no network service.

reader.interface: proposed read-only TaskHandle reader of current quality fact, acceptance wrapper and nested raw refs; never infer from the test title or parser output

effect_observation.positive_predicate: For the same authenticated Task, material revision and snapshot, independently read raw decision-log U/V/R sections without calling deriveDecisionLogOriginalSourceCensus; require nonzero U/V source units, R-001..R-008 links and no missing section, then require a bound build-code AC-26 fact and acceptance wrapper reporting the matching successful outcome. A source-only parser GREEN is insufficient.
effect_observation.negative_predicate: Reject a bound AC-26 pass if a required U/V/R section is absent, the independently counted source denominator is zero, an R link is missing, or the raw stage evidence disagrees with the fact.

rule.statement: Acceptance evidence admits the eight listed result values; missing, inconsistent, incomplete and unavailable remain incomplete in quality-store verification, while invalid values are rejected.

normal.precondition: An acceptance leaf carries one of the eight allowed results.
normal.input: Validate the leaf and pass it through the focused quality-store helper.
normal.observable_success: The value is accepted; the four machine classes map to incomplete rather than passed.
normal.observable_failure: An allowed machine class is rejected or silently mapped to passed.

failure.precondition: The result value is not in the eight-value list.
failure.input: Submit a bogus value such as timed_out.
failure.observable_success: Validation rejects the value and identifies the allowed values.
failure.observable_failure: The bogus value becomes pass, fail, or an accepted ninth value.

boundary.precondition: Freshness checks encounter a new nonterminal machine class.
boundary.input: Evaluate missing, inconsistent, incomplete and unavailable at the existing freshness call site.
boundary.observable_success: No acceptance outcome mismatch is thrown merely because the value is a listed nonterminal class.
boundary.observable_failure: The validator accepts a value that freshness rejects or quality-store marks passed.

recovery.precondition: A previously deferred leaf receives a later valid recorded result.
recovery.input: Re-evaluate through the existing evidence helpers without rewriting the earlier fact.
recovery.observable_success: The new result is evaluated on its own evidence while the prior deferred fact remains intact.
recovery.observable_failure: The old result is overwritten or the new result is silently declared passed.

cases.risk: Helper-level acceptance does not prove CARD-05 production-stage emission or historical 123-record byte compatibility; the authenticated historical baseline is unavailable. Independent business-effect evidence remains unknown because no separate before/after reader has been authenticated.

rule.statement: Acceptance evidence admits the eight listed result values; missing, inconsistent, incomplete and unavailable remain incomplete in quality-store verification, while invalid values are rejected.

normal.precondition: An acceptance leaf carries one of the eight allowed results.
normal.input: Validate the leaf and pass it through the focused quality-store helper.
normal.observable_success: The value is accepted; the four machine classes map to incomplete rather than passed.
normal.observable_failure: An allowed machine class is rejected or silently mapped to passed.

failure.precondition: The result value is not in the eight-value list.
failure.input: Submit a bogus value such as timed_out.
failure.observable_success: Validation rejects the value and identifies the allowed values.
failure.observable_failure: The bogus value becomes pass, fail, or an accepted ninth value.

boundary.precondition: Freshness checks encounter a new nonterminal machine class.
boundary.input: Evaluate missing, inconsistent, incomplete and unavailable at the existing freshness call site.
boundary.observable_success: No acceptance outcome mismatch is thrown merely because the value is a listed nonterminal class.
boundary.observable_failure: The validator accepts a value that freshness rejects or quality-store marks passed.

recovery.precondition: A previously deferred leaf receives a later valid recorded result.
recovery.input: Re-evaluate through the existing evidence helpers without rewriting the earlier fact.
recovery.observable_success: The new result is evaluated on its own evidence while the prior deferred fact remains intact.
recovery.observable_failure: The old result is overwritten or the new result is silently declared passed.

cases.risk: Helper-level acceptance does not prove CARD-05 production-stage emission or historical 123-record byte compatibility; the authenticated historical baseline is unavailable. Independent business-effect evidence remains unknown because no separate before/after reader has been authenticated.

rule.statement: The current decision-log original-source census must parse its U/V/R sections with a nonzero U/V denominator, no parser errors, and R-001..R-008 index entries.

normal.precondition: The authenticated current decision-log contains all three required source sections.
normal.input: Parse the actual decision-log through deriveDecisionLogOriginalSourceCensus.
normal.observable_success: status=present, errors=[], entries and source_units each >=8, and R-001..R-008 indexed.
normal.observable_failure: A missing source section, empty denominator, or parser error is observable.

failure.precondition: A source section is missing from an in-memory copy.
failure.input: Remove the verbatim section before invoking the same parser.
failure.observable_success: The parser reports a named missing-section error.
failure.observable_failure: The mutated material yields errors=[] or is counted as covered.

boundary.precondition: U/V source lines and R index rows occupy distinct namespaces.
boundary.input: Parse the U/V/R rows in the current decision-log.
boundary.observable_success: U/V entries form the denominator; R entries are trace links, not added source units.
boundary.observable_failure: R rows inflate the source denominator or a required R ID is absent.

recovery.precondition: A missing section has been restored using authenticated material.
recovery.input: Reparse the corrected decision-log without changing the parser.
recovery.observable_success: The previously missing source section is recognized and parser errors clear.
recovery.observable_failure: The repaired text remains unparseable or the denominator stays zero.

cases.risk: A zero or inflated original-source denominator could make later coverage claims misleading; the focused parser test alone does not prove the official AC-26 diagnostic or phase conclusion. Independent business-effect evidence remains unknown because no separate before/after reader has been authenticated.
